subject: vault-island-interior-rebuild

explicitJourneyDecisions: The palace entry is a massive, mostly empty ceremonial atrium.
The atrium has at least two very tall architectural floors.
A monumental staircase splits in two and descends toward the vault.
The palace dome must be legible from inside.
Separate side stairs or portals connect the atrium to the gardens.
The underground destination is a luxurious museum vault for inspectable treasures.

secondaryInteriorHypothesis.allowedUse: architectural hierarchy, spacing, materials, and lighting only

currentResult.userAssessment: very far from where it should be

dominantFailures: atrium reads as exposed blockout rings and floating steps rather than a monumental palace interior
wall courses are oversized dark blocks with no carved arcade, cornice, niche, or panel hierarchy
split stair has insufficient mass, stringers, landings, balustrade continuity, and believable support
two tall floors are represented by rails rather than inhabited architectural galleries
dome underside and oculus do not dominate the upper interior composition
vault room is visually congested at the center while its surrounding museum architecture remains sparse
treasure displays lack the disciplined radial spacing and premium glass-case rhythm of the interior target
lighting is broad and flat instead of layered warm coves, case lights, and a controlled blue focal glow
detailFirewall: no extra treasure ornament before atrium shell and stair silhouette pass
no sparkle or animation polish before museum spacing and wall bays pass
no micro-carving before the two-floor hierarchy reads at 390x844
no gameplay or collection-state changes in this visual rebuild
